text: We recommend beginning with an Aura Refresher, which helps assess your current spiritual energy and identify any blockages or negative influences affecting your path. NOT SURE WHERE TO START?

When life feels stagnant or opportunities seem out of reach, many people seek spiritual guidance to help create a fresh path forward. The Fresh Start (Road Opener) service is centered on encouraging the release of energetic obstacles and promoting a clearer path toward new beginnings.

This spiritual work focuses on removing energetic blockages, lingering negativity, and influences that may be slowing your personal growth or preventing forward movement. Through prayer and intention, the session is designed to encourage renewed momentum, helping create space for love, prosperity, success, and new opportunities to enter your life more freely.

The Fresh Start service is especially beneficial after periods of feeling spiritually weighed down, experiencing repeated setbacks, or seeking a renewed sense of direction. At Divine Brujita DJ, each session is performed with care and devotion to support clarity, balance, and positive forward movement.

Please Note: This service is provided for entertainment purposes only and is based on personal spiritual beliefs and practices. It is not intended to guarantee specific outcomes or replace professional legal, financial, medical, or mental health advice. No specific results are guaranteed.

The Aura Refresher (Egg Cleanse) is a traditional spiritual practice centered on clearing away heavy, stagnant, or unwanted energy while encouraging balance, clarity, and renewal. Many people choose this service when they feel spiritually overwhelmed, emotionally drained, or simply want a fresh energetic start.

During the session, Divine Brujita DJ performs the cleanse with prayer and spiritual intention while also seeking insight into the energy surrounding the individual. This process may provide guidance regarding emotional, spiritual, and energetic influences that could be affecting your current path.

If you are seeking support for a loved one, an Aura Refresher may also be requested on their behalf. Divine Brujita DJ works through the spiritual connection established with the client to perform the session with the same care and intention.

This service is often recommended as a first step before other spiritual work, as it may help provide a clearer understanding of your current energetic state and identify areas where additional spiritual support may be beneficial.

All-Around Spiritual Protection

For continuous protection, this work should be refreshed every 3 months. Regular refreshing helps renew and strengthen the protective energy so your spiritual shield remains supported over time.

The Poof! Be Gone service is a spiritually guided ritual centered on clearing away unwanted influences, heavy energy, and connections that no longer serve your highest good. Performed with prayer and spiritual intention, this ritual is designed for those seeking a fresh spiritual path free from lingering negativity and unwanted attachments.

Whether the source is a difficult relationship, unhealthy friendship, family conflict, disruptive coworker, or another unwanted influence, this spiritual work is intended to encourage separation from heavy energies that may be interfering with your sense of peace, clarity, and personal growth. The focus of this ritual is to spiritually clear the path so you can move forward with greater balance, confidence, and inner harmony.

Each session is performed with compassion, devotion, and respect for your personal intentions. While no specific results can be promised or guaranteed, this ritual offers spiritual encouragement for those seeking release from unwanted influences and a renewed sense of peace and freedom.

Please Note: This service is provided for entertainment purposes only and is based on personal spiritual beliefs and practices. It is not intended to guarantee the removal of any person or situation from your life, nor does it guarantee any specific outcome. No specific results are guaranteed.
Cloaking — Shield Me

Cloaking is a spiritual privacy working created to place an energetic veil around you and your personal life. Its intention is to make your energy more difficult to access, interpret, or read when others attempt to look into your life through tarot cards, spiritual readings, divination, or other intuitive practices.

Rather than focusing only on protection from negativity, Cloaking is designed to conceal your energy and personal matters from unwanted spiritual observation, helping keep your relationships, plans, movements, intentions, and private circumstances spiritually hidden.

This work is ideal for those who feel others may be attempting to read their energy, investigate their personal life through divination, or gain spiritual insight into matters that are not theirs to access.
For continued spiritual privacy and cloaking, refreshing this work every 3 months is recommended.
Spiritual services are based on personal beliefs and traditions. Results and experiences may vary, and no specific outcome is guaranteed.
